description: This file implements a sample Ruby client for interacting with the Testlink API via XML-RPC. It defines a class to encapsulate API calls, initializes a client instance, and performs a test call to report test case results.

classes.name: TestlinkAPIClient
classes.description: A Ruby class to encapsulate interaction with the Testlink API via XML-RPC, providing an initializer with server setup and a method to report test case results.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the API client with a server URL and sets up the XMLRPC client.

methods.name: reportTCResult
methods.description: Sends a test case result report to the Testlink server with provided test case ID, plan ID, and status.
